Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Seeing the doctor soon? Put every medicine you take into one bag and bring it to us first. 🩺 In Episode 9 of our Uncle Lim family story, Mei finds a clinic follow-up card hidden under the fridge magnet, and her father's medicines spread across the kitchen cupboard, the bedside drawer and an old cookie tin. At Alpro Pharmacy KSL City Mall, our pharmacist lays every box out on the counter and asks Uncle Lim one simple question, so he can do the talking himself. Three easy steps before your next follow-up in Johor Bahru: gather all your medicines, vitamins, herbal products and creams into one bag; write down three questions in your own words; bring someone along to drive and take notes. Walk in for medication counselling or a Minute Consult with our pharmacist, no appointment needed. Your doctor's plan always comes first. Ground Floor, Lot G-001, KSL City Mall, Taman Abad, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 10AM to 10PM.
